$comment: Generated by scripts/build-tools.mjs from each Actor's public Apify input schema. Do not edit by hand; run `npm run build:tools`.

tools.name: junglee--amazon-bestsellers
tools.title: Amazon Bestsellers Scraper
tools.description:
Amazon Bestsellers Scraper. Scrape the Amazon Best Sellers categories and extract details on top 100 most popular items on Amazon. Download product name, price, URL, and thumbnail image. Best used on .com, .co.uk, .de, .fr, .es, and .it domains. Download your data in various formats: HTML table, JSON, CSV, Excel, and more.

When to use: Use when you need the top 100 Amazon Best Sellers for a category URL (name, price, rank, URL, image).

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "junglee/amazon-bestsellers" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/junglee/amazon-bestsellers

categoryUrls.title: Amazon category URLs
categoryUrls.description: Pick one or a few Best Seller categories to scrape. If you enter a top-level category, all subcategories will be scraped (up to max depth). Category URL has to contain Best-Sellers , best-sellers or bestsellers . To see examples of all accepted URLs, check out the readme . Example: ["https://www.amazon.com/Best-Sellers-Electronics/zgbs/electronics/"]

maxItemsPerStartUrl.title: Max results (per start URL)
maxItemsPerStartUrl.description: Enter the maximum number of results you want to scrape per each star URL. Note that Amazon has a hard limit of 100 bestsellers per category. Example: 100

depthOfCrawl.title: How many subcategories do you want to scrape?
depthOfCrawl.description: Amazon Best Sellers covers 42 main categories. Each of those have at least one more subcategory level. Setting this field to 2 will get you roughly 550 subcategories, each with 100 results.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language to use on Amazon. **Disclaimer**: each Amazon domain has a different set of supported languages. If you choose a language that is not supported by the domain, the scraper will use the default language of the domain.

detailedInformation.title: Detailed information
detailedInformation.description: Check this if you want to get the maximum amount of information about individual products. However, choosing this option means the scraper could take longer, since it is extracting more data.

useCaptchaSolver.title: Use Captcha solver (warning: see description)
useCaptchaSolver.description: If enabled the scraper will automatically solve captchas thrown by Amazon. This will decrease the amount of request retries and increase the speed of the scraper. ***IMPORTANT*** - This option works well only for the `'.com'` Amazon domain, but even for that one Amazon doesn't show a few product fields after solving a captcha (specifically: 'attributes', 'manufacturer attributes', and 'bestseller ranks')

tools.name: junglee--amazon-reviews-scraper
tools.title: Amazon Reviews Scraper
tools.description:
Amazon Reviews Scraper. Amazon scraper to extract reviews from Amazon products. Scrape and download detailed reviews without using the Amazon API, including rating score, review description, reactions and images. Download your data as HTML table, JSON, CSV, Excel, XML.

When to use: Use when you need the customer reviews of specific Amazon products (rating, text, date, reactions, images).

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "junglee/amazon-reviews-scraper" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/junglee/amazon-reviews-scraper

productUrls.title: URLs of Amazon products
productUrls.description: Enter the URL or URLs of the Amazon products you want to scrape. (E.g., https://www.amazon.com/Sceptre-E248W-19203R-Monitor-Speakers-Metallic/dp/B0773ZY26F). Click + Add to scrape multiple URLs at once. Example: [{"url":"https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0CWXNS552"}]

maxReviews.title: Max reviews per product (max count depends on the type of reviews)
maxReviews.description: Type in the amount of reviews to be scraped. Leave this blank if you want to extract all reviews. ❗ Note: max amount of reviews per product is 100 per star count (e.g. 100 reviews per 1 star), 100 per product variant (100 reviews per each product variant), several hundred for media reviews, ~20 for keyword search Example: 100

includeGdprSensitive.title: Include personal information
includeGdprSensitive.description: Personal data such as name, ID or profile image is protected by GDPR in the European Union and by other regulations around the world. You should not scrape personal data unless you have a legitimate reason to do so. [Read more](https://blog.apify.com/is-web-scraping-legal/).

sort.title: Sort reviews by
sort.description: Select by which criteria the reviews should be sorted. Amazon's default is Top reviews . Options: helpful = Top reviews; recent = Most recent.

reviewsCutoffDate.title: Newer than
reviewsCutoffDate.description: Limit how far back to the history the scraper should go. The date should be in YYYY-MM-DD or full ISO absolute format or in relative format e.g. 1 days, 2 months, 3 years. All time values are taken in UTC timezone. The maximum reviews per product we can get is 100.

filterByRatings.title: Filter by ratings
filterByRatings.description: Select the number of stars by which reviews should be filtered. Amazon's default is All stars . Duplicate reviews, caused by selecting overlapping ratings (e.g., 1 star and All critical ) will be filtered out.

reviewsUseProductVariantFilter.title: Scrape a single product variant
reviewsUseProductVariantFilter.description: If the product has multiple variants (e.g., different colors, sizes, etc.) , you can scrape reviews only for the selected variant.

reviewsFilterByKeywords.title: Search by keywords
reviewsFilterByKeywords.description: Enter keywords by which the reviews should be filtered. Each keyword is scraped separately, in a combination with Filter by ratings option. Duplicate reviews, caused by selecting overlapping keywords, will be filtered out. Example keywords that get lots of results: `["Good", "Bad", "Great", "Quality", "Useful", "Love", "Price"]`

scrapeProductDetails.title: Scrape product details
scrapeProductDetails.description: If enabled, the Actor will scrape and save product data the same way as the [Amazon Product Scraper](https://console.apify.com/actors/BG3WDrGdteHgZgbPK). The product details will be available in the `product` output field.

reviewsAlwaysSaveCategoryData.title: Always save category data
reviewsAlwaysSaveCategoryData.description: If enabled, the Actor will return the review category data even if there are no reviews. - Normally, only reviews are saved, if there are no reviews, the review category data is not saved. - With this option, the review category data will be saved alone, if there are no reviews (review fields are empty).

deduplicateRedirectedAsins.title: Deduplicate redirected ASINs
deduplicateRedirectedAsins.description: If set, the crawler will deduplicate the redirected ASINs (by default). Otherwise the product will be saved multiple times under the ASINs it was redirected to.

tools.name: caffein-dot-dev--ebay-sold-listings
tools.title: eBay Sold Listings Search
tools.description:
eBay Sold Listings Search. Get confirmed eBay sold prices. Search by keyword across 8 marketplaces, filter by date range, and export clean structured data for comps, resale pricing, and market research.

When to use: Use when you need what items actually sold for on eBay (sold comps) for a keyword, marketplace and date range.

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "caffein.dev/ebay-sold-listings" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/caffein.dev/ebay-sold-listings

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: One or more search keywords. Each keyword runs as a separate search with the same filters applied to all. Example: ["rtx 4080"]

keyword.title: Keyword (deprecated — use Keywords)
keyword.description: Single search keyword. Deprecated: use the 'keywords' array field instead.

search.title: Search (deprecated — use Keywords)
search.description: Deprecated: alias for the single-keyword `keyword` field. Use the `keywords` array instead. Accepted for backward compatibility with callers that send `search`. Backslash-escaped quotes (\") in the value are unescaped before the search runs.

categoryId.title: Category
categoryId.description: eBay category ID — maps directly to the `_sacat` URL parameter. Enter ANY eBay category ID as free text; you are not limited to a preset list. Use "0" (the default) for All Categories. Don't know the ID? We maintain the full, up-to-date list of category & subcategory IDs at https://sold-comps.com/ebay-categories

subcategoryId.title: Subcategory
subcategoryId.description: Optional eBay subcategory ID — also maps to `_sacat`. Enter ANY subcategory ID as free text. When set, it overrides the Category field above. Leave blank to search at the category level. Full ID reference: https://sold-comps.com/ebay-categories. The output record's `categoryId` / `category` fields reflect the effective category actually used for the search.

ebaySite.title: eBay Site
ebaySite.description: eBay site to scrape from Options: ebay.com = eBay.com (US); ebay.co.uk = eBay.co.uk (UK); ebay.de = eBay.de (Germany); ebay.fr = eBay.fr (France); ebay.it = eBay.it (Italy); ebay.es = eBay.es (Spain); ebay.ca = eBay.ca (Canada); ebay.com.au = eBay.com.au (Australia).

daysToScrape.title: Days to Scrape
daysToScrape.description: Number of days back to scrape sold listings (default: 30)

sortOrder.title: Sort order
sortOrder.description: Sort order for the sold search results page. Options: endedRecently = Ended recently; timeNewlyListed = Time: newly listed; pricePlusPostageLowest = Price + postage: lowest first; pricePlusPostageHighest = Price + postage: highest first; distanceNearest = Distance: nearest first.

buyingFormat.title: Buying format
buyingFormat.description: Search-page buying format filter. Options: all = All; auction = Auction; buyItNow = Buy It Now; acceptsOffers = Accepts Offers.

itemLocation.title: Item location
itemLocation.description: Search-page item location filter. Options: default = Default; domestic = Domestic only; worldwide = Worldwide.

sellerCountry.title: Seller country
sellerCountry.description: Only return listings from sellers located in this country. Two-letter ISO code, e.g. JP or GB . When set, the Item location filter is ignored. If no listing matches, eBay can return listings from other countries: check itemLocation on each item. Country codes

postalCode.title: Delivery postal code
postalCode.description: Delivery postal code for more accurate shipping prices, in the format of the selected eBay site (e.g. a ZIP code on ebay.com, SW1A 1AA on ebay.co.uk). Leave blank to use a central postcode for the site. A value in the wrong format is ignored with a warning.

itemCondition.title: Condition
itemCondition.description: Search-page condition filter. Options: any = Any; new = New; used = Used.

conditionId.title: Condition ID
conditionId.description: Numeric eBay condition ID — overrides itemCondition when set.

sellerType.title: Seller type (EU sites only)
sellerType.description: Filter by seller type. EU sites only — works on ebay.de, ebay.fr, ebay.it and ebay.es. On all other sites this filter is ignored and results are unfiltered. Options: any = Any; private = Private; business = Business.

aspectFilter.title: Aspect filter
aspectFilter.description: eBay aspect facet filters, e.g. {"Brand": "Nike"}. Keys and values are double-encoded per eBay's convention.

includeCompletedListings.title: Include Completed Listings
includeCompletedListings.description: When true (default), includes eBay's Completed Listings filter alongside the Sold filter. This enables accurate detection of 'Best Offer Accepted' listings via the listingType and isBestOfferAccepted fields. When false, uses only the Sold filter — all results are guaranteed sold items, but Best Offer Accepted items will appear as regular 'buy_it_now' with the asking price shown as soldPrice.

exactMatch.title: Exact match
exactMatch.description: When true (default), eBay's loosened 'results matching fewer words' items are removed so only listings closely matching the keyword are returned. Set to false to include them.

tools.name: unseenuser--TikTok-Shop-Scraper
tools.title: TikTok Shop Scraper [NO COOKIES] ✅
tools.description:
TikTok Shop Scraper [NO COOKIES] ✅. Extract product data, reviews, seller info, creator affiliates, and GMV/sales estimates from TikTok Shop at scale. Filter by category, price range, and country (US, UK). Built for dropshippers, e-commerce sellers, and DTC brands hunting trending products before they go viral.

When to use: Use for TikTok Shop products, reviews, sellers, creator affiliates and GMV/sales estimates by category, keyword, shop or product URL.

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "unseenuser/TikTok-Shop-Scraper" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/unseenuser/TikTok-Shop-Scraper

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Pick what you want to scrape. The matching section below has the same emoji.

searchKeywords.title: Search keywords
searchKeywords.description: What you'd type into TikTok Shop's search bar. One per line.

shopUrls.title: TikTok Shop store URLs
shopUrls.description: Full store URLs. On the app, tap a shop name and copy the link. Format: https://www.tiktok.com/shop/store/ /

productUrls.title: Product PDP URLs
productUrls.description: Full product detail page URLs. Right-click any TikTok Shop product and copy the link. Format: https://www.tiktok.com/shop/pdp/ /

usernames.title: TikTok usernames
usernames.description: TikTok handles, one per line. The @ prefix is optional - both 'hyram' and '@hyram' work.

region.title: TikTok Shop region
region.description: The United States is the only fully supported market and the only one this Actor is tested against. The other markets are selectable and sometimes return data, but they are unreliable and may come back empty or with fields missing (no review counts, no seller location). Treat anything other than US as unsupported and unwarranted. Leave this set to US.

sortBy.title: Shop Catalog sort order
sortBy.description: Only used in Shop Catalog mode. 'Best selling' surfaces a store's proven winners; 'Newest' surfaces what they just launched. Options: top = 🔥 Best selling (default); new_releases = 🆕 Newest releases.

maxResults.title: Max results per input (0 = everything)
maxResults.description: 0 = return all available results (no limit). Any other number is a limit per query, shop or creator: with 5 keywords and 100 here, you get up to 500 rows in total. There is no ceiling on this number. Nothing is capped for technical reasons, so if you want to control spend, use this run's "max items" setting, which limits what you are charged for.

maxReviewsPerProduct.title: Max reviews per product (0 = every review)
maxReviewsPerProduct.description: 0 = fetch every review the product has (no limit). Only used in Product Reviews mode. There is no ceiling here either, so be aware that popular products can carry tens of thousands of reviews and each review is one billable row. Use this run's "max items" setting if you want a hard stop on spend.

getRelatedVideos.title: Include related affiliate videos
getRelatedVideos.description: Only used in Product Details mode. Adds a relatedVideoCount field. The affiliate videos themselves are returned either way, so this changes very little - it is hidden from the form and kept only so that previously saved runs stay valid.

tools.name: publicrecords--etsy-shop-velocity
tools.title: Etsy Shop Sales Tracker & Scraper
tools.description:
Etsy Shop Sales Tracker & Scraper. Track Etsy shop sales counters with this Etsy shop scraper: measured sales counts with the date each was read.

When to use: Use when you need how many sales an Etsy shop has made, or how fast shops are selling, filtered by shop name, title keyword, category or change date. Returns one row per shop with the measured sales counter and the date it was read.

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "publicrecords/etsy-shop-velocity" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/publicrecords/etsy-shop-velocity

shops.title: Shop names
shops.description: Etsy shop names (the part after etsy.com/shop/). Leave empty to use the keyword or category filters. Example: ["OrelCeramics","Bestickend"]

keywords.title: Keywords in shop title
keywords.description: Case-insensitive words matched against the shop title and headline.

category.title: Panel category
category.description: Exact panel category label, matched case-insensitively, e.g. "kids & baby > toys", "home & living > home decor > scatter cushions", "art & collectibles > fine art ceramics". The label is filled for about 0.7% of shops, so a category filter returns only those shops. Empty = all.

minSales.title: Minimum lifetime sales
minSales.description: Only shops at or above this sales counter.

since.title: Changed since (date)
since.description: ISO date. Return only shops whose counters changed since this date. Empty = all matching shops.

maxShops.title: Max shops
maxShops.description: Upper bound on rows returned (and charged).

tools.name: publicrecords--etsy-search-scraper
tools.title: Etsy Scraper — Listings, Prices & Best Sellers
tools.description:
Etsy Scraper — Listings, Prices & Best Sellers. Scrape Etsy search results by keyword, category or market page: title, price, rating, reviews, Bestseller and Star Seller badges, ad flag and search rank.

When to use: Use when you need what ranks on Etsy for a keyword, category or market page: position, price, rating, review count, Bestseller/Star Seller badges and whether the listing is an ad.

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "publicrecords/etsy-search-scraper" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/publicrecords/etsy-search-scraper

queries.title: Search keywords
queries.description: Keywords to search, one per line (e.g. ceramic mug). Each keyword lands on Etsy's /market page, then pages through Etsy's own search API — every listing on the page (rendered and lazy-loaded), in Etsy's rank order. Example: ["ceramic mug"]

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Order of results, as on Etsy's own sort menu. Applies to search keywords (a market phrase with a sort set runs as a keyword search). Options: relevance = Relevance (Etsy default); newest = Newest; price_asc = Price: low to high; price_desc = Price: high to low; top_reviews = Top customer reviews.

maxPrice.title: Max price
maxPrice.description: Highest price to include, whole units. Leave empty for no maximum.

marketPhrases.title: Market phrases
marketPhrases.description: Phrases for Etsy's /market/ pages (any phrase resolves). Example: personalized dog collar

categoryUrls.title: Category URLs
categoryUrls.description: Etsy category pages, e.g. https://www.etsy.com/c/jewelry/necklaces (no query string). Read in Etsy's default order.

maxPages.title: Max pages per input
maxPages.description: Pages per input, 1–20 (Etsy's own cap). On the Standby/MCP endpoint one call stops at 240 s and says so (truncated:true with pagesDone/pagesRequested); big jobs belong in a batch run.

maxItems.title: Max listings per run (0 = no cap)
maxItems.description: Stop after this many listing rows across all inputs. Raise it (or set 0 for no cap) to get more pages.

maxCacheAgeHours.title: Max snapshot age (hours)
maxCacheAgeHours.description: Serve a keyword from our recent snapshot of the same search when it is at most this many hours old and holds every row you asked for; otherwise fetch live. Snapshot rows say data_source "cache", stale true and as_of (when they were read live), and are charged like live rows. 0 = always fetch live.

fillLazyCards.title: Return every listing on the page
fillLazyCards.description: Etsy renders 12 cards and lazy-loads the rest (48 more on page 1). On, the run fetches them the way Etsy's own page does, so you get the whole page in rank order. Off, you get the 12 rendered cards per page only (faster, fewer requests on your proxy).

is_best_seller.title: Bestseller badge
is_best_seller.description: Keeps listings shown with Etsy's Bestseller badge on the search page.

is_star_seller.title: Star Seller shops only
is_star_seller.description: Only return listings from Star Seller shops.

free_shipping.title: Free shipping only
free_shipping.description: Only return listings with free shipping.

is_discounted.title: On sale only
is_discounted.description: Only return listings currently on sale.

is_handmade_only.title: Handmade only
is_handmade_only.description: Only return listings Etsy flags as handmade.

is_personalizable.title: Personalizable only
is_personalizable.description: Only return listings that offer personalization.

max_processing_days.title: Ready to ship within (days)
max_processing_days.description: Only return listings whose processing time is at most this many days (Etsy's ready-to-ship filter).

ship_to.title: Ships to (country code)
ship_to.description: Two-letter code, e.g. US, GB, DE.

source.title: Source
source.description: Optional free-text label for this run (for example the Make template that started it). Copied onto every listing row and onto RUN_SUMMARY so template runs can be filtered. Leave empty if you do not need it.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Etsy blocks datacenter IPs. Default: Apify Proxy RESIDENTIAL, included in the event prices (no separate proxy or compute charge). Your own residential proxy works too. A blocked page is never charged.

useApifyProxy.description: Use Apify Proxy for requests. Leave the default unless the Actor's README says otherwise.

annotations.title: Etsy Scraper — Listings, Prices & Best Sellers
